UC-820.en: On Windows, Clauseo stops Claude's and ChatGPT's file tools from opening or changing another matter's files, and refuses their commands that name another matter's folder. It can't catch everything: a program they write and run, a file location they piece together, or a shortcut they make first can still reach those files.
UC-820.note: Describes the launch build's command scan (Claude and ChatGPT). If a case is still open at the cut, the list grows on the day (host follow-ups).

UC-850.en: For matters that must stay strictly apart, use a Mac.
UC-850.note: A product statement only Rohan can make; shown after UC-820 only if he keeps it.
